full_judgment: 17. The courts below further held that the mere assertion of the defendants that they did not execute the registered pattas of the year of 1952-53 in favour of the plaintiffs' predecessor is not enough. They must seek relief before a competent court for declaration that the pattas, were forged and fraudulent but that has not been done. It may be mentioned here that a registered document carries with it a presumption that the executants appeared before the concerned Sub-Registrar and admitted execution the document. The plaintiffs did not make any attempt to rebut this presumption.
